# 3D First-Person Game

A simple 3D first-person game using Babylon.js with WASD and arrow key controls.

## Project Setup

This is a web-based 3D game project using Babylon.js engine.

- **Engine**: Babylon.js
- **Controls**: WASD (movement) + Arrow Keys (camera rotation)
- **Development Server**: Live Server

## Running the Project

1. Open `index.html` in VS Code
2. Use the Live Server extension to run the project
3. Or use the "Launch Live Server" task from VS Code

## Project Structure

```
JG.3DGame/
├── index.html       # Main game HTML
├── style.css        # Game styling
├── game.js          # Game logic and scene setup
└── README.md        # Documentation
```

## Controls

- **W/A/S/D** - Move forward/left/backward/right
- **Arrow Keys** - Look around (camera rotation)
- **Mouse** - Additional camera control (optional)
